sections.faq:
❓ Is Euverify- GPSR, CE & UKCA for WooCommerce compatible with all WooCommerce themes?

✅ Yes, the plugin is designed to work seamlessly with most WooCommerce-compatible themes.

❓ Can I add custom fields in the GPSR tab?

⚙️ Currently, the plugin supports predefined fields. For advanced customization, you can modify the code or contact support.

❓ Does this plugin support multi-language websites?

🌍 Yes, the plugin is translation-ready and supports WordPress localization standards.

sections.description:
This plugin adds fields for manufacturer, importer, and certifications to ensure compliance with EU GPSR, CE, and UKCA regulations.

🛡️ Description

The Euverify GPSR Plugin empowers WooCommerce site owners to display essential product safety information. In compliance with the General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR), Regulation (EU) 2023/988, this plugin simplifies your adherence to regulatory responsibilities for product listings, ensuring compliance with EU and UK market regulations, including Northern Ireland.

🌟 Key Responsibilities Addressed by the Plugin:

Product Safety Information Display
✅ Includes clear and accurate product descriptions, relevant warnings, and safety labels as required by legislation.
✅ Displays product identification and traceability information directly to consumers.

—

Who Needs This Plugin?
This is ideal for eCommerce sites selling products in the EU and UK markets, ensuring compliance and transparency.

—

🎯 Features

✅ Separate GPSR Safety Tab: Adds a separate safety tab in product listings for a clean, non-intrusive display.
✅ Compliance Ready: Fully compatible with UKCA, CE, and GPSR standards.
✅ Customizable Tab: Allows merchants to easily customize safety-related fields through a dedicated GPSR tab in WooCommerce Product Data.
✅ Product Manufacturer Details: Input and display manufacturer name, address, and contact information.
✅ Authorized Representative Details: Easily include EU and UK authorized representative information.
✅ Document Uploads:
🗂️ Certificate of Analysis
🗂️ Certificate of Conformity
🗂️ Declaration of Conformity
🗂️ Instruction for Use
🗂️ User Manuals
🗂️ Safety Data Sheets
🗂️ Installation Instructions
🗂️ Troubleshooting Guides
🗂️ Additional Safety Documents

✅ Safety Information: Add safety statements or other key notices for customer awareness.

—

🌐 Responsibilities of eCommerce Companies Under GPSR

✅ Ensure detailed product information and safety documentation are visible to customers.
✅ Provide manufacturer and importer identification details.
✅ Guarantee product traceability for authorities and consumers.
✅ Prevent the sale of unsafe or non-compliant products through diligent product monitoring.

—

🔗 Useful Links

✅ General Product Safety Regulation (GPSR): Learn how GPSR impacts Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon sellers. Read More
✅ Authorized Representative (AR) in the UK and EU: Understand their role and importance for compliance. Read More
✅ Compliance Regulations in the EU: Discover the roles and responsibilities of manufacturers, distributors, importers, and fulfillment service providers. Read More
✅ Appoint an EU Authorized Representative: Find out how to designate an AR in the EU or UK for your business. Learn More
✅ Instantly Generate an EC Declaration of Conformity: Simplify the process of creating an EC Declaration of Conformity. Generate Now

—

🛠️ Installation

  1. 📥 Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress Admin Panel.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  4. Click Upload Plugin, select the ZIP file, and click Install Now.
  5. After installation, click Activate Plugin.

—

🚀 Usage Instructions

  1. Navigate to the product editor in WooCommerce.
  2. Locate the new Euverify tab in the product data section.
  3. Enter the relevant details (e.g., Product manufacturer, Responsible Person Details, Product Documents).
  4. Save the product to display these details on the product page.

—

📧 Support

For support and feature requests, please contact us at support@euverify.com.

💻 Start customizing your WooCommerce store today with Euverify- GPSR, CE & UKCA for WooCommerce! 🚀

—
